item.title: Marshalls shares slip after revenue dips in first half
item.summary: The market reaction to Marshalls’ first-half results seemed a little unjust on Monday as shares in the building supplies group dropped despite profit increasing. Marshalls delivered higher first-half profit and raised its dividend despite flat revenue, as cost savings and sharper execution triumphed over subdued demand across much of the building products market.
